camerashake.official: Applies shaking to the players' camera with a specified intensity and duration.

changesetting.official: Changes a setting on the dedicated server while it's running.

clearspawnpoint.official: Removes the spawn point for a player.

clone.official: Clones blocks from one region to another.

damage.official: Apply damage to the specified entities.

daylock.official: Locks and unlocks the day-night cycle.

deop.official: Revokes operator status from a player.

dialogue.official: Opens NPC dialogue for a player.

enchant.official: Adds an enchantment to a player's selected item.

event.official: Triggers an event for the specified object(s)

execute.official: Executes a command on behalf of one or more entities.

fill.official: Fills all or parts of a region with a specific block.

fog.official: Add or remove fog settings file

function.official: Runs commands found in the corresponding function file.

gamerule.official: Sets or queries a game rule value.

give.official: Gives an item to a player.

hud.official: Changes the visibility of hud elements.

inputpermission.official: Sets whether or not a player's input can affect their character.

kick.official: Kicks a player from the server.

locate.official: Displays the coordinates for the closest structure or biome of a given type.

loot.official: Drops the given loot table into the specified inventory or into the world.

mobevent.official: Controls what mob events are allowed to run.

music.official: Allows you to control playing music tracks.

op.official: Grants operator status to a player.

packstack.official: Prints client or server pack stack to chat

place.official: Places a jigsaw structure, feature, or feature rule in the world.

playanimation.official: Makes one or more entities play a one-off animation. Assumes all variables are setup correctly.

recipe.official: Unlocks recipe in the recipe book for a player.

reload.official: Reloads all function and script files from all behavior packs, or optionally reloads the world and all resource and behavior packs.

reloadconfig.official: Reloads configuration files relating to variables, secrets, permissions, etc.

reloadpacketlimitconfig.official: Reload packet limit config from file

ride.official: Makes entities ride other entities, stops entities from riding, makes rides evict their riders, or summons rides or riders.

save.official: Control or check how the game saves data to disk.

say.official: Sends a message in the chat to other players.

schedule.official: Schedules an action to be executed once an area is loaded, or after a certain amount of time.

scoreboard.official: Tracks and displays scores for various objectives.

scriptevent.official: Triggers a script event with an ID and message.

sendshowstoreoffer.official: Sends a request to show a store offer to the target player.

serveridentity.official: Manages the server identity key. Use save, delete, or status.

setblock.official: Changes a block to another block.

setmaxplayers.official: Sets the maximum number of players for this game session.

spawnpoint.official: Sets the spawn point for a player.

structure.official: Saves or loads a structure in the world.

tell.official: Sends a private message to one or more players.

tellraw.official: Sends a JSON message to players.

testfor.official: Counts entities (players, mobs, items, etc.) matching specified conditions.

testforblock.official: Tests whether a certain block is in a specific location.

testforblocks.official: Tests whether the blocks in two regions match.

tickingarea.official: Add, remove, or list ticking areas.

time.official: Changes or queries the world's game time.

titleraw.official: Controls screen titles with JSON messages.

transfer.official: Transfers a player to another server.

wsserver.official: Attempts to connect to the websocket server on the provided URL.
